title: 写作练笔 #1 · 雅思话题短句
topic: IELTS 话题短句 · 高频语法结构
goal: 从简单句子开始练写作：用 5 个高频语法结构各写 1-2 句雅思话题短句。每题 2 分，满分 10。

questions.prompt:
用现在完成时写 1-2 句，描述近几年在线课程的发展趋势。
提示词：online courses / gain popularity / transform

answer.rubric: ① 使用现在完成时（have/has done）② 全句时态一致 ③ 用上提示词 ④ 1-2 句

questions.explanation: 示范句：Online courses have gained increasing popularity in recent years, and digital learning has transformed the way students access education.

questions.prompt:
用比较级结构写 1-2 句，对比城市与乡村生活的某一方面（生活成本、节奏或环境任选其一）。
提示词：expensive / quiet / pace

answer.rubric: ① 至少一处比较级（-er 或 more...than）② 对比逻辑清晰 ③ 词汇拼写准确

questions.explanation: 示范句：Living in cities is usually more expensive than living in the countryside, but rural areas often offer a quieter and slower pace of life.

questions.prompt:
用被动语态写 1-2 句，描述一项环保政策正在被实施（垃圾分类、限塑令等任选）。
提示词：carry out / introduce / ban

answer.rubric: ① 至少一处被动语态（be + 过去分词）② 被动结构时态正确 ③ 语义通顺

questions.explanation: 示范句：A new waste-sorting policy has been introduced in many cities, and strict rules are being carried out in public venues.

questions.prompt:
用 because 写 1-2 句，解释为什么久坐对健康有害。
提示词：sedentary / lead to / posture

answer.rubric: ① 使用 because 引导原因状语从句 ② 因果关系逻辑正确 ③ 用上提示词

questions.explanation: 示范句：Sitting for long hours is harmful to health because a sedentary lifestyle can lead to back problems and poor posture.

questions.prompt:
用 although 写 1-2 句，表达远程办公既有好处也有不便。
提示词：flexible / isolation / commute

answer.rubric: ① 使用 although/while 引导让步状语从句 ② 好坏两面都提到 ③ 主从句时态一致

questions.explanation: 示范句：Although working from home offers a more flexible schedule, some employees still suffer from a sense of isolation.
